metadataExportTab.intro: Publish this organization's governed metadata — tables, columns, domains, stewards, approved relationships and column-level lineage — to the external data catalogs below. Publication is outbound only: Provisa never reads a target catalog back as a source of truth.
metadataExportTab.notEntitled: Metadata export requires the {{tier}} plan. Upgrade to configure catalog targets.
metadataExportTab.gcpProjectHelp: The project the data products are created in.
metadataExportTab.gcpLocationHelp: The Dataplex location, such as us or europe-west1.
metadataExportTab.awsRegionHelp: The region of the DataZone domain, such as us-east-1.
metadataExportTab.datazoneDomainIdHelp: The domain the data products are published in.
metadataExportTab.datazoneProjectIdHelp: The project that owns the data products and approves subscriptions.
metadataExportTab.deltaShare: Also publish each product as a Delta Share
metadataExportTab.deltaShareHelp: Other data teams receive the share once a Databricks admin grants it to their recipient. Only members stored in Delta can be shared.
metadataExportTab.secretHelp: Stored credentials are never displayed. Leave blank to keep the current one; clear and save to remove it.
metadataExportTab.reconcileCronHelp: Cron expression for the full-snapshot reconcile that corrects drift. Leave empty to publish on change only.
metadataExportTab.noTargets: No targets yet. Add the catalogs this organization publishes to.
metadataExportTab.targetIdHelp: A short name for this target, unique in the organization (for example openmetadata-prod). Two targets may use the same catalog type.
